decision.scope: Owner-approved HABB expression system for Benchmark 001. A brand decision for HABB, not a Nordla default.

governance.reason: This content, unchanged, is the expression_system of the APPROVED HABB Brand Memory V1.1 produced through the real Branding governance (see habb-brand-canonical-v1.json).

principles: realistic and credible product photography
natural or controlled studio lighting
soft directional light rather than flat lighting
materials and textures must look real
the product must remain immediately identifiable
images must not have a generic AI-generated look
do: use clean, sober backgrounds
use realistic stone, marble, studio or physical surfaces only when relevant
preserve natural shadows and believable depth
keep lighting coherent across product and scene
preserve sufficient contrast between product and background
dont: beige as a generic AI-style default
decorative leaves or foliage added automatically

principles: the real HABB product is authoritative
the creative adapts to the product, never the opposite
real dimensions, proportions and distinctive details must be preserved
personalisation must remain visible and readable
the product is the hero of the composition
do: preserve original product pixels whenever possible
prefer cut-out and compositing over product regeneration
generate or compose the environment around the product
add realistic shadow/reflection only when it does not alter the product
allow controlled relighting only when product colours remain truthful
show enough of the product to understand immediately what is being sold
dont: regenerate a real product when the real asset exists
change phone-case cut-outs, buttons, camera holes, shape, proportions or material
modify a face appearing in a customer's personalisation/photo
distort a person's face, body or identity

principles: editorial composition rather than generic advertising-template composition
strong visual breathing room
immediately understandable hierarchy
product dominance
simple does not mean empty
premium does not mean decorated
do: reserve text space before generating or composing the environment
use negative space intentionally
create one clear focal point
balance product, text and environment
allow asymmetry when it strengthens the composition
preserve clear space around the product
dont: add ornaments only to make the design feel premium

principles: layout is built around the product and the message
hierarchy must be clear
alignments must be intentional
margins and spacing must feel generous
product and text must never collide
price and primary promise must remain readable
do: reserve safe text areas
respect the placement/channel facts supplied by Marketing
trigger re-layout when text does not fit
keep spacing rhythm coherent
dont: shrink text below minimum readable size
place a headline over an essential part of the product
use the exact same placement for every creative
turn all HABB content into one repetitive template

principles: illustration is secondary
illustration must never compensate for a weak product asset
illustration must remain simple and relevant
do: allow illustration only when explicitly required by the creative concept
allow illustration when it is itself part of the customer's personalisation

principles: functional before decorative
simple
coherent
immediately readable
do: use icons only when they materially improve comprehension
keep a clean, geometric and consistent icon style
dont: generic icon collections used as decoration
stars, crowns, diamonds or badges to simulate premium

principles: motion must be useful, not demonstrative
product identity must remain stable
pacing should feel modern and controlled
motion serves comprehension
do: product reveal
subtle zoom
believable camera movement
limited typographic animation
clean transitions
dont: effects that look like an AI demo

notes: Motion is part of the expression system but NOT_APPLICABLE to Benchmark 001, which is a static Instagram Feed still.
locale_overrides is deliberately absent: no cultural difference was evidenced; the global HABB rules apply.
reference_asset_refs is deliberately empty: no approved reference asset exists yet.
